newsitem.title: RUSSIA: French President impressed by Yeltsin recovery.
newsitem.headline: French President impressed by Yeltsin recovery.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac said after talks with Boris Yeltsin on Sunday he was impressed by the speed of the Russian leader's recovery from pneumonia and heart surgery.

Chirac was speaking to reporters at Moscow's Vnukovo-2 airport after an afternoon of talks at Yeltsin's country residence. The talks had been extended by an hour for further discussion of European security issues.
"I was impressed by the speed of his recovery," Chirac said.

"I found him as always extraordinarily well informed about all the problems of the world which we discussed together and very tough in the defence of Russia's interests, which is entirely legitimate."
He said they had spoken for more than three hours, and Chirac had accepted an invitation to return to Moscow for a visit on September 26-27.
Earlier in the day Yeltsin had looked in good humour when greeting Chirac at his Novo-Ogaryova residence. He walked a little stiffly but seemed quite animated and the tone of his voice was steady.
